entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, there has been no sign yet of[n]Kaneshiro acting on his threat.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He prolly thinks his money's[n]just gonna come rolling in.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He does have the upper hand[n]on us, after all...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If that picture got out, who knows what[n]would end up happening to [fName]...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess worst-case scenario'd[n]be he gets expelled.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, there is a more serious[n]alternative... He's currently[n]under probation, meaning...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I'm so sorry. This whole[n]situation is my fault.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, stop that. I mean,[n]you're the one who's in the[n]most trouble right now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My sister is a prosecutor... This[n]will surely be a problem for her[n]as well. What should I do...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Kaneshiro must surely be taking[n]that aspect into account too...
We need to stop him.
Let's change his heart.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For sure. Even the police are[n]having trouble with that bastard.[n]We'll be heroes if we catch him!!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: High risk, high reward...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're all so positive...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... In a way, your recklessness[n]is the only reason we are now able[n]to pursue this change of heart.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Totally. We're in deep shit,[n]so we're gonna do whatever[n]we can to get out of it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... never thought of things[n]in that way before.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is quite strange hearing[n]something so positive from Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shuddup!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right, Leader! You can[n]decide when we meet up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When your position changes, your view[n]of the world changes too. It's a shift in[n]cognition.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In any case, we're in big trouble if we[n]can't change Kaneshiro's heart. Let's[n]do this.
